title: Two Information Channels, One Design Limit: An Information-Theoretic Framework for Generative AI in Synthetic Gene-Circuit Design
description: Theoretical preprint developing a two-stage information-channel abstraction for separating generative proposal uncertainty from context-dependent biological realization uncertainty in synthetic gene-circuit design. All reported numerical examples are analytical or synthetic; no experimental biological data are reported. Prepared as metadata only; no Zenodo deposition or DOI is implied.
